newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish govt postpones '98 budget talks to Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Polish govt postpones '98 budget talks to Thursday.

text.p: The Polish government postponed talks on the 1998 budget draft to Thursday after some ministers asked for more time read finance ministry materials saying they received them late, the government spokeswoman said on Tuesday.
"The 1998 budget assumptions will be passed at an extra government meeting on Thursday," Aleksandra Jakubowska told journalists.
She said that Finance Minister Marek Belka proposed a budget deficit of 1.9 percent of the gross domestic product in 1998 against 2.8 percent gap planned for this year.
